sources.definition: Enrolled mobile students from abroad. Atlas disciplines group published ISCED-F categories: Computer Science uses ICT, Engineering uses engineering and engineering trades, and Medicine and Healthcare uses health. Counts refer to the published categories, which can include adjacent subjects. The all-level total covers ISCED 5–8. Degree-specific rows are disaggregations of that total. The selected fields do not cover the entire curriculum. Publisher estimates, provisional values, and breaks in series can occur; consult the linked dataset flags before comparison.

sources.definition: Students who crossed an international border to study. Origin follows prior education, with residence or citizenship used where necessary. Counts describe enrolment in each reference year. The worldwide value is published by UIS. Some published values contain fractions and are rounded to the nearest student. Available bilateral corridors are a subset. Missing observations are omitted.

visa.name: F-1 academic student visa
visa.requirements: An SEVP-approved school issues Form I-20 following acceptance. Register in SEVIS, pay the required fee and follow your consulate’s application instructions.
visa.proof: A consular officer may ask how you will pay educational, living and travel costs. Use the budget provided by your school.
visa.work: Eligible on-campus employment generally has a 20-hour weekly limit while classes are in session. Off-campus employment requires separate eligibility and authorization.
visa.post: Eligible F-1 graduates can apply for Optional Practical Training in their field, with a school endorsement and USCIS employment authorization.

cost.note: MIT undergraduate academic year, before aid. Other combines the $420 student life fee, $930 for books and supplies, and $2,496 in personal expenses. Add travel and any health insurance premium separately.

visa.name: Student visa
visa.requirements: Applicants need an offer from a licensed sponsor, a Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies, and evidence that they meet the English and financial requirements where applicable.
visa.proof: The financial test normally includes first-year course fees plus £1,529 per month in London or £1,171 elsewhere for up to nine months. Where evidence is required, check the 28-day holding rule and exceptions.
visa.work: Work permission depends on the course and whether it is term time. Check the conditions attached to your immigration status.
visa.post: The Graduate visa generally lasts two years for applications through 31 December 2026 and 18 months from 1 January 2027. Eligible doctoral graduates can apply for three years.

cost.note: UCL Management MSc. Twelve months in London at £793 monthly survey rent. UCL’s 52-week estimates cover food, transport, course materials, phone and wellbeing. Insurance uses one year of the student immigration health surcharge. Visa duration, housing and bills change the amount.

visa.name: Residence permit for studying
visa.requirements: Germany’s study residence permit generally requires admission to higher education, secure living costs and adequate health insurance. Check nationality-specific entry visa requirements before travel.
visa.proof: The Berlin immigration authority lists €992 per month, or €11,904 for 2026, as the financial requirement for study. Accepted evidence depends on the case.
visa.work: The study residence permit generally permits 140 full workdays per calendar year. Check how your individual work schedule counts against this allowance.
visa.post: After a qualifying German degree, graduates can apply for a job-search residence permit, generally lasting up to 18 months.

cost.note: Two semesters of TUM Informatics MSc at €6,000 each for fee-paying international students. Living costs annualize DAAD’s national monthly survey categories. Other includes €97 per semester plus recreation, clothing, materials and communications. Munich housing can exceed the national figure.

visa.name: Study permit
visa.requirements: Most international students need a study permit and a letter of acceptance from a designated learning institution. Check whether a provincial or territorial attestation letter is required.
visa.proof: For applications from 1 September 2026 outside Quebec, one applicant must show CAD 23,448 in first-year living funds plus tuition and transportation. Family size and Quebec rules change the requirement.
visa.work: Eligible students can work off campus up to 24 hours per week during regular terms and may work more during scheduled breaks if all conditions continue to be met.
visa.post: Graduates of eligible programs at designated institutions may qualify for a post-graduation work permit. Duration and eligibility depend on the program, passport and applicable requirements.

cost.note: UBC Vancouver Science BSc scenario: 30 credits at CAD 1,769.40. Insurance uses 12 months of BC’s CAD 75 international student health fee after MSP enrollment. Enter rent, meals, travel, other student fees and any extra health plans from your own quotes.

visa.name: Student visa, subclass 500
visa.requirements: Applicants normally submit a Confirmation of Enrolment, satisfy the Genuine Student requirement and maintain Overseas Student Health Cover unless exempt.
visa.proof: Applicants may need to show funds for travel, tuition and living costs. Check the Home Affairs document checklist for the relevant evidence.
visa.work: Most students can work up to 48 hours per fortnight while their course is in session. Different rules apply during breaks and to eligible research master’s or doctoral students.
visa.post: Eligible graduates can apply for a Temporary Graduate visa, subclass 485. Eligibility and duration depend on the stream and personal circumstances.

cost.note: University of Melbourne Master of Computer Science indicative first-year fee and a one-bedroom metropolitan flat at AUD 475 per week for 52 weeks. The rent guide does not state a survey year. Add other costs, including an individual OSHC quote.

universities.name: Massachusetts Institute of Technology
universities.tuition: USD 66,720 undergraduate tuition for 2026/27 before financial aid.
universities.admissions: International first-year applicants follow MIT’s undergraduate application process. Review school records, testing and English-language guidance for your school system.

universities.name: University College London
universities.tuition: GBP 44,400 for the Management MSc in 2027/28. Other courses publish separate fees.
universities.admissions: Management MSc requires at least a UK upper second-class bachelor’s degree or an overseas equivalent. Consult each course for its own language and subject requirements.

universities.name: Technical University of Munich
universities.tuition: EUR 6,000 per semester for fee-paying international students from third countries on these two MSc programs, plus the semester fee. Exemptions and waivers may apply.
universities.admissions: Applicants need a recognized undergraduate degree, relevant preparation and a successful aptitude assessment. Language evidence depends on the program.

universities.name: University of British Columbia
universities.tuition: CAD 1,769.40 per Science credit for new international students in 2026/27. Tuition depends on degree, entry cohort and course load.
universities.admissions: Applicants must meet general and degree-specific requirements for their secondary school curriculum. Vancouver Science students apply for a specialization after their initial admission.

universities.name: University of Melbourne

programs.name: Doctor of Philosophy – Engineering and IT

universities.tuition: AUD 68,480 indicative annual international fee for the Master of Computer Science in 2027. Actual fees depend on enrolled subjects.
universities.admissions: The Master of Computer Science requires a relevant bachelor’s degree, a 75% weighted average or equivalent, university-level mathematics or statistics, and English proficiency. Consult the full entry criteria.

universities.name: Princeton University
universities.tuition: USD 68,140 undergraduate tuition for 2026/27 before aid. Graduate study has a separate fee and funding structure.
universities.admissions: Computer Science PhD applicants identify up to two research areas. The graduate school publishes the program-specific documents and deadlines for each intake.

universities.name: University of Oxford
universities.tuition: GBP 46,210 per year at the overseas fee rate for History entrants in 2027. Check each degree for its own fee.
universities.admissions: History lists AAA at A-level, or an equivalent qualification, and requires submitted written work. See the subject-specific instructions.

universities.name: Heidelberg University
universities.tuition: EUR 1,500 per semester for many non-EU/EEA students with a foreign university entrance qualification, plus separate semester charges. Exemptions apply.
universities.admissions: Computer Science begins in the winter semester, with instruction in German and partly English. Use the university’s admissions guide for your qualifications and language evidence.

universities.name: University of Waterloo
universities.tuition: CAD 73,000 for Computer Science and CAD 75,000 for Engineering in estimated first-year international tuition and incidental fees for two terms, September 2026 entry.
universities.admissions: Computer Science has mathematics and English requirements. Qualification equivalents, required forms and deadlines are listed by curriculum on the admissions page.

universities.name: Monash University
universities.tuition: AUD 58,940 per 48-credit-point year on the international Bachelor of Computer Science fee schedule for 2027.
universities.admissions: Computer Science applicants must meet mathematics and English requirements. Use Monash’s qualification lookup to find the recognized equivalents for your curriculum.

scholarships.name: MIT Scholarship
scholarships.funding: Need-based institutional grant. Amount varies with demonstrated financial need.
scholarships.deadline: Early Action and Regular Action use different financial aid deadlines.
scholarships.note: For MIT undergraduate students who apply for need-based aid. Submit the required financial aid documents.

scholarships.name: UCL Global Master’s Scholarship
scholarships.note: For lower-income overseas-fee applicants to full-time, in-person taught master’s programs. Check the official page for the next cycle.

scholarships.name: Chevening Scholarship in India
scholarships.funding: Fully funded one-year taught master’s scholarship, subject to award terms.
scholarships.note: For eligible Indian citizens. Work experience, eligible courses and a return-home commitment form part of the application criteria.

scholarships.name: TUM Scholarship for International Students
scholarships.deadline: Check the semester-specific opening and closing dates on the award page.
scholarships.note: For enrolled students with financial need and good performance who meet study-semester and nationality-related BAföG requirements. Entry-stage applicants generally cannot apply.

scholarships.name: UBC International Major Entrance Scholarship
scholarships.funding: CAD 10,000–25,000 per year for 2027/28. Renewable for up to three further years.
scholarships.note: Automatic consideration for qualifying new international students entering directly from secondary school on a Canadian study permit. Academic achievement and extracurricular involvement are assessed.

scholarships.name: Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarships
scholarships.funding: Competitive stipend and fee-offset awards include AUD 41,100 per year at the 2027 full-time rate.
scholarships.deadline: New applicants must apply by their research course closing date.
scholarships.note: For eligible research master’s and doctoral candidates. Scholarship type, research potential and study duration determine the award.

exchange.note: Currency units per EUR. Indicative reference rates exclude bank spreads and transaction fees.
